label: to review
research: The Innichen archival abstract names Michael von Rosenberg as Hofmeister and one of four Freising regents granting Georg von Welsperg holdings in the Puster Valley. 1499-09-09.json, 1499-09-14.json and 1499-09-14_2.json name the same four regents and securely identify the same Hofmeister. The supplied study’s Boxberg attribution relies on treating those companion records as already confirmed. Their archival abstracts establish the office and council membership and give no family seat, kinship or other link to the Michael documented at Boxberg. The third impressions on the first two companion documents belong to Michael, but their heraldry could not be read securely from the available images (https://www.gda.bayern.de/gvl/document/1ec6872b-273f-4c03-affd-8d9ac358283e and https://www.gda.bayern.de/gvl/document/6adeefaa-c870-462e-8475-a49d75ac3149). Franken is possible given the contemporary Michael with Boxberg and Bauland holdings under Elector Philipp’s protection (1482-01-13.json and 1490-10-28.json), but the Bishop of Freising was the elector’s son (https://www.deutsche-biographie.de/sfz56167.html), and no source reviewed connects the Hofmeister to that Michael. The Puster Valley holdings are the bishopric’s, so they give no positive link to the Tyrolean Triest or Rosenstein families or to the Bohemian Rožmberks. Family attribution remains open.

entries.source: Innichen Stiftsarchiv Innichen Urkunden Urk. 548 516, Urk. 548
entries.german: Die vier Regenten des Bischofs von Freising Philipp Pfalzgraf bei Rhein, Johann von Lamberg (Domdekan zu Freising), Ruprecht Auer (Domherr), Michael von Rosenberg (Hofmeister) und Warmund von Fraunberg zum Huebenstein, verleihen dem Georg von Welsperg den halben Hof zu Zell unter Welsberg, das Halbe Gut zu Winkel hinter der Burg Welsperg und ein Gut zu Toblach als Zinslehen. S: Johann von Lamberg Or. Perg., 1 anh. Siegel
entries.english: The four regents of the Bishop of Freising, Philipp Count Palatine of the Rhine—Johann von Lamberg (Dean of the Cathedral Chapter at Freising), Ruprecht Auer (Canon), Michael von Rosenberg (Steward), and Warmund von Fraunberg zum Huebenstein—grant Georg von Welsperg half the farm at Zell unter Welsberg, half the property at Winkel behind Welsperg Castle, and a property at Toblach as a Zinslehen (rented holding). S: Johann von Lamberg Or. Perg., 1 attached seal

facts.content: served as one of four regents of Philipp, Bischof von Freising and Pfalzgraf bei Rhein.

granted Georg von Welsperg half a farm at Zell unter Welsberg, half a holding at Winkel behind Welsberg Castle, and a holding at Toblach as a Zinslehen, jointly with Hans von Lamberg, Domdekan zu Freising, Ruprecht Auer, Domherr, and Warmund von Fraunberg zu Hubenstein.
sealed the grant of the Zinslehen to Georg von Welsperg.
